748.title: Create DHCP over VPN configuration with the Remote Management IP Address in Remote Gateway.
748.result:
1.Do auth and login https://{IP}/api/sonicos/auth
  2.Get get https://{IP}/api/sonicos/vpn/dhcp-over-vpn/base/remote .
  { "vpn": { "dhcp_over_vpn": { "remote": { "bound_to": "X0", "accept_bridged_wlan_request": false, "relay_ip": "10.0.0.2", "management_ip": "0.0.0.0", "block_spoof": true, "temp_lease": true, "lease_time": 2 } } }}3.Create DHCP over VPN configuration with the Remote Management IP Address in Remote Gateway.4.Do put https://{IP}/api/sonicos/vpn/dhcp-over-vpn/base/remote{ "vpn": { "dhcp_over_vpn": { "remote": { "bound_to": "X0", "accept_bridged_wlan_request": false, "relay_ip": "10.0.0.1", "management_ip": "10.0.0.2", "block_spoof": true, "temp_lease": true, "lease_time": 2 } } }}5.Do pending changes .
